data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis, CRITICAL): The helper MUST pair halves via a machine-readable reserved tag migration-role:<role> (role ∈ automated-sweep/manual-verification/rollback/rollback-verification/flag-cutover/flag-cleanup) on the pair-half task tickets — NOT by parsing task titles/description prose (brittle, non-deterministic). Query via the ticket CLI (e.g. ticket list/show tags). This convention is the producer/consumer contract with the emitter stories (1c2b/ef21/c5fa), which write the tag at emission. Verify: grep -qiE 'migration-role|--has-tag|tags' plugins/dso/scripts/sprint/apply-two-pass-ordering.sh
